{{Quote|Contact Obi-Wan. Stubby, scramble secret code set 1477. I don't want that station to pick this up.|Anakin Skywalker to R3-S6|<ref name="Duel">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>}}
'''Scramble code 1477''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] encryption code used for secret transmissions.

==History==
Shortly before the [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|Mission to Skytop Station]] in [[22 BBY]], the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] detected the secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatist]] listening post [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] in the orbit of [[Ruusan 2/Legends|Ruusan 2]]. He instructed the [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] [[R3-S6/Legends|R3-S6]] to use scramble code 1477 in order to contact the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] without the station picking them up. Skywalker reports to Kenobi, who eventually tells him to sneak onboard the separatist outpost. R3-S6, who turned out to be a separatist [[Agent/Legends|agent]], would later contact [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and tell him about the Jedi intrusion.<ref name="Duel" />
